title: Project Evaluation
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a macro view of a project, taking into consideration the project's impact on society."
Economic analysis is a macro view of a project, taking into consideration the project's impact on society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to sales for which payment is not made immediately."
Credit sales refer to sales for which payment is not made immediately.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the firm's short term investment in shares, bonds and other securities."
Marketable securities are the firm's short term investment in shares, bonds and other securities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a must if we are to understand the nature of competition in industry."
Understanding supply is a must if we are to understand the nature of competition in industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of future cash flows."
Ability to service debts is a function of future cash flows.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the net present value (NPV) method and the internal rate of return (IRR) method."
The two methods are the net present value (NPV) method and the internal rate of return (IRR) method.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the total value of goods or service sold to third parties."
Total sales are the total value of goods or service sold to third parties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the issue of resource control and the attendant political and social implications."
Complicating the discussions is the issue of resource control and the attendant political and social implications.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a forecast of the revenues, expenses and the net profit of an enterprise or project."
The projected income statement is a forecast of the revenues, expenses and the net profit of an enterprise or project.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most popular methods of project evaluation."
The Payback Period The payback period is one of the most popular methods of project evaluation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first stage of a project cycle."
The Project Idea Stage The project idea stage is the first stage of a project cycle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the starting point of our discussions concerning the project and the external environment which is the market."
Demand analysis is the starting point of our discussions concerning the project and the external environment which is the market.
fib: ______ is the private sector's view of a project without considering a project's impact on the society.
Financial analysis
Financial analysis is the private sector's view of a project without considering a project's impact on the society.
______ is a tool for subjecting cash flows to risk analysis.
Sensitivity analysis
Sensitivity analysis is a tool for subjecting cash flows to risk analysis.
______ refers to the total demand within a set geographical area like Nigeria.
Total market demand
Total market demand refers to the total demand within a set geographical area like Nigeria.
______ are the difference between total sales revenue and credit sales.
Cash sales
Cash sales are the difference between total sales revenue and credit sales.

Operating at maximum efficiency
Operating at maximum efficiency means that the relevant machinery and equipment should be routinely serviced.
______ is the outlay incurred to acquire some asset.
Cost
Cost is the outlay incurred to acquire some asset.

cash flow statement
A cash flow statement is a statement that shows the actual receipt of cash (inflows) and the disbursement of cash (out flows) of a firm or project.
______ is an important aspect of our study of project evaluation.
Project cost analysis
Project cost analysis is an important aspect of our study of project evaluation.

Actual capacity

Project demand
Project demand is a subset of the total market demand.

Long Term Liabilities Long-term liabilities

Acceptability
Acceptability means that consumers are willing to pay for the goods or services.
